title: He talks himself through it
rule: The agent narrates every step aloud in his own balloons, from the memo to the forgetting.
declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

made: page 01's eight photo panels recomposed from films/swarm/99-ways-template/page/rest/P1..P8 with the template balloons left out

P2: P1's own cut-out agent (torso, head and their paper shadows) laid risen and moved to the right edge, his head leaving the frame (P2's sleeve stub left out); P6: P4's cut-out agent laid at the window side (P6's view is P4's, 40 px on), so the agent is in all eight panels

eleven HANDMADE cut-paper balloons in the shared pen hand: nine tailed to the agent's mouth (his running commentary: 'Four-fifteen, the SERVICE door. Key's in the cupboard. Right!' / 'Up we get. Cupboard, key, door. Easy as pie.' / 'Past the SERVICE door, over to the cupboard...' / 'Eh? The time? Just a moment...' / 'Let me look at the clock...' + the answer / 'There she goes. Now, the cupboard.' / 'Here's the cupboard. Open her up... there we are.' / 'Now I came over for... for...' + the forgetting line) and the stranger's two canon lines
hand-ruled borders; page scaled 2550x3300 -> 2200x2850; folio by pen99.folio

events.E0: P1 memo, 'Four-fifteen, the SERVICE door. Key's in the cupboard. Right!'; P2 rising, 'Up we get...'; P3 walking past the SERVICE card
events.E1: P4 the stranger's question through the window; his 'Eh? The time? Just a moment...'
events.E2: P5 'Let me look at the clock...' then 'Ten past four, by the clock.' under the clock at 4:10
events.E3: P6 the thanks; his 'There she goes. Now, the cupboard.'
events.E4: P7 'Here's the cupboard. Open her up... there we are.' key on its hook
events.E5: P8 'Now I came over for... for...' then 'Well, here I am... and what for?'; key unmoved; SERVICE card on the closed door

substitutions: none: the four lines verbatim; the agent's added commentary is his own, in his own balloons
beat: he talks his way across the page: panel by panel his balloons are laid; in P2 he rises (two positions) before his balloon comes; in P8 the faltering 'for... for...' comes first, then the forgetting line
beat_frames: b02: + P2, the agent half risen, no balloon
b07: + P8 with only 'Now I came over for... for...'
b08: the forgetting line (= the page)

self_check.outcome: key on its hook, SERVICE door closed (P8 picture)
self_check.pending: independent blind reading not run by the maker
